name: country-label
title: Country label
description: A country, language or currency named in the reader's language from a code, with its flag tile: for tables, addresses and profiles, with no data file.
docs: Names come from Intl.DisplayNames. The flag is built from regional indicator letters in a tile of fixed size, so a platform without flag glyphs shows the two letters and the layout does not move. Chrome and Edge on Windows are such a platform: add a flag polyfill font such as Twemoji Country Flags to the font stack of your page to show flags there. Languages and currencies get a tile with their code or symbol; an unknown code shows itself, or your fallback.
